A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE link(s) in the References section.", "title": "Topic"}, {"category": "general", "text": "Kiali 2.27.4, for Red Hat OpenShift Service Mesh 3.4, provides observability for the service mesh by offering a visual representation of the mesh topology and metrics, helping users monitor, trace, and manage efficiently.

Security Fix(es):

* CVE-2026-45820 openshift-service-mesh/kiali-rhel9: fflate: Denial of Service via crafted ZIP archives (OSSM-15737)
* CVE-2026-45820 openshift-service-mesh/kiali-ossmc-rhel9: fflate: Denial of Service via crafted ZIP archives (OSSM-15740)
* CVE-2026-75838 openshift-service-mesh/kiali-ossmc-rhel9: DOMPurify: Cross-Site Scripting via IN_PLACE sanitization (OSSM-15747)
* CVE-2026-75838 openshift-service-mesh/kiali-rhel9: DOMPurify: Cross-Site Scripting via IN_PLACE sanitization (OSSM-15748)
* CVE-2026-84375 openshift-service-mesh/kiali-ossmc-rhel9: js-yaml: Denial of Service vulnerability in YAML parsing (OSSM-15850)
* CVE-2026-84375 openshift-service-mesh/kiali-rhel9: js-yaml: Denial of Service vulnerability in YAML parsing (OSSM-15851)
* CVE-2026-56860 openshift-service-mesh/kiali-rhel9: golang net/url: Denial of Service from quadratic complexity in path resolution (OSSM-15404)
* CVE-2026-56862 openshift-service-mesh/kiali-rhel9: Golang crypto/tls: Denial of Service via indefinite KeyUpdate messages (OSSM-15447)
* CVE-2026-33818 openshift-service-mesh/kiali-rhel9: Go encoding/asn1: Denial of Service via excessive recursion in Unmarshal (OSSM-15457)

Bug Fix(es):

* OSSM-15616 Service Mesh console only shows one control plane revision in Namespaces view during RevisionBased upgrade

mitigations: There is no available mitigation for this flaw other than updating the bundled fflate library to a fixed version (0.8.3 or later). Where the application controls the input, avoid passing untrusted ZIP archives to fflate's unzip()/unzipSync() APIs.

To mitigate this vulnerability, avoid using DOMPurify with a custom IN_PLACE sanitization configuration that includes an element-removal hook. Default DOMPurify configurations are not affected by this flaw.
